text_block_list.text: The Classic Year spring GI campaign is finally right around the corner...!
Meanwhile, Mejiro Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ââHaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
......Phew.
Trainer, what's my time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's another goal accomplished, isn't it?

Mejiro Ardan is steadily
accumulating both skill and experience...!

With this, we can aim for an even higher stage.
And... she must be well aware of that herself.
If it's "now"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There's something I'd like to consult you about.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I was waiting for you.
Yeah, I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we change locations for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —The Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Would you permit winning that supreme raceto be my ultimate goal for the Classic year?"

As she said that upon returning to the trainer's office,
Mejiro Ardan's eyes held a stronger determination
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...As you know, my sister, Mejiro Ramonu,
was the first ever to achieve the Triple Tiara,
and is hailed as the 'Jewel of the Mejiros'—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"And as her younger sister,
I am constantly overshadowed by her illustrious presence."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I want to escape from that shadow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Not as "Mejiro Ramonu's sister,"
but as an individual—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As "Mejiro Ardan,"
I want to leave a trail of light in this "now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a presence that shines so brilliantly
it completely eclipses Sister's majestic light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I wish to achieve results
on a different path from my sister—
the Classic Triple Crown route.
choice_data_list: ...Can I ask why you're choosing the Derby?
...Can I ask why you're choosing the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...The biggest reason is my body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Regrettable though it may be to admit... running in all three Triple Crown races would impose an unprecedented burden on one's body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If assuming a rotation where she enters every race
only leads to an unfocused, scattered record across the Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A single-minded breakthrough. I wish to focus my "now"
on the stage that all Umamusume yearn for:
the 'Japanese Derby.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, if you judge that I am capable
of taking on the entire Triple Crown, Trainer,
I will follow your lead."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is simply my own personal resolve to face the Japanese Derby in this manner.
If you could understand just that much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think?
Trainer, your thoughts are—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: I want to aim for the Japanese Derby too.
I want to aim for the Japan Derby too.

text_block_list.text:
The stage upon which Mejiro Ardan could engrave her brilliance into history.
By the time she reached the Classic Year, it had naturally been decided.

The race so many Umamusume yearn for, strive for, and run for.
A once-in-a-lifetime, fleeting pinnacle.
It has to be the Nippon Derby.

Even if she hadn't suggested it,
as the one who envisions her "future,"
I surely would have made running in that race our ultimate goal.
choice_data_list: The "current" you can definitely aim for it.
The "current" you can definitely aim for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I am truly, deeply grateful for your trust.
choice_data_list: First, let's aim for the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.text:
I agree with focusing on the Japan Derby,
but going in cold without a prep race is simply too risky.

"To raise our odds of winning even slightly,
I should set a mid-term goal to build experience for the Japanese Derby..."

Since the Aoba Sho is held at the same venue
as the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby),
it serves as an ideal trial race to gauge a runner's chances.

Additionally, being a GII race,
it should be less taxing than the Triple Crown GI circuit.
It makes for an ideal mid-term target.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. ...We must devote ourselves
and work even harder from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...The higher the summit we aim for, and the more
our aspirations align, the more one's heart
thrills like this, doesn't it?"

And so, alongside Mejiro Ardan,
we took a new step forward toward
the greatest battle of the Classic Class...!
Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Not enough.
Like this, I still haven't—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“—From the races up to today, I've come to understand it well.
There truly are powerful contenders in this world who far exceed my imagination.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In contrast, I am weak.
Mind, technique, body... Not a single part of me is sufficient.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, I have not the slightest
intention of halting my stride."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What I sought in racing was an encounter with the strong.
At the end of that clash, beyond victory itself,
lies the true strength I aspire to reach...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Therefore... the Classic Triple Crown, every last one.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Not to Ardan-san, not to Chiyono O-san,
not to anyone... no matter how strong...――"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of backing down!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Such a beautiful sunset.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Producing results in the Junior Class gave me confidence.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, maybe I could even win
the Nippon Derby...—
For just a second, that's what crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ――Yaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, that acceleration timing was too late.
I need to be mindful of my ultimate top speed
from an earlier phase...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer!
Please, one more time!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san, such incredible drive...――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though Ardan-san achieved solid results during the Junior Class,
she wasn't satisfied with that."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Unlike me, without a single shred of "peace of mind,"
she always threw herself into training with everything she had...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —I can't go on like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Stupid, stupid, I'm so stupid!
I don't have time to be relaxing!
I need to do more, much more—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —I need to push myself even further.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because I...
want to win the Japanese Derby...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have to win...
Because there's someone I want to stand beside as an equal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —"Today's sweat will become tomorrow's tears!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The competition in the 'Japanese Derby'
will undoubtedly be the deepest yet...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Especially—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—Chiyono O-san and Yaeno-san.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Their performances are especially remarkable. They are sure to be my greatest rivals in the Nippon Derby as well...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ――No, that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Remember. What is it that I must overcome "right now"?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (It is the radiance of that crowning treasure that still shines above me, casting me into its shadow—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(No matter who my opponent is,
I must first focus on executing
my own race to completion...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Inevitably, the results will show right there—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The Aoba Sho...
"For now," all I must do is hone myself for it.
